title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 44 (Link Island)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Link Island
44 That portion of M.U. 1-1 in the Strait of Georgia which is contained within the following described boundary: The mean low water mark of Link Island.
